name: devbrain
description: Persistent memory for your coding agent. It writes down what it fixes and decides as it works, and reads it back before the next task. Matches on wording and on exact error text, with no model and no account needed.

mongodb_uri.title: MongoDB connection string
mongodb_uri.description: Optional. Leave empty to keep memory in a local file at ~/.devbrain/db.json. Set it to share one memory across machines or a team.

dashboard_token.title: Dashboard token
dashboard_token.description: Only needed to reach the dashboard from another machine. Left empty, the dashboard answers on localhost only and needs no token.
